mapping.rationale: Teaching has the strongest visitor-facing learning program and an existing inquiry CTA.
The page explicitly describes roles, implementation, verification, and portfolio production.
The gallery is already structured as grouped, explainable concept material rather than a new destination.
Career is a chronological journey, making a ship-threshold metaphor legible without declaring ship-deck exploration.

alternative.mapping: Hall → gallery.html; Harbor Archive → teaching.html; Workshop → making.html; Hero Ship → career.html.
alternative.tradeoff: Hall-as-gallery is visually literal, but Archive-as-teaching weakens the direct inquiry path and makes the archive less semantically distinct.

poiContentMappingOptions.principle: A spatial POI is an orientation unit, not a one-page limit. One POI may later expose multiple subtopics/pages without requiring another building.

canonicalR4.activation: E emits canonical-interaction; no HTML navigation in that scene

r5RecommendedInteraction.approach: named exterior approach / threshold; E and Enter show/open the mapped page; pointer or touch taps the visible prompt; no auto-navigation on proximity
r5RecommendedInteraction.mobile: Large visible tap target and accessible text prompt; touch activation must use the same destination contract.

returnToWorld.existing: Browser Back returns to the prior World URL. The four current HTML pages have no direct world/ link.
returnToWorld.proposed: Add an explicit relative world/ return link only in a later approved implementation pass; do not implement in Phase D.

worldExtentOptions.currentUse: Four POI core only; future content becomes a separately loaded area.
worldExtentOptions.artRequirement: Author edge continuation, off-core terrain/water transitions, and camera-safe background; do not scale/paste the 1280×720 Beauty Master.

worldExtentOptions.reservePolicy: East/right reserve stays scenic water and inactive until a seam is separately approved.
worldExtentOptions.artRequirement: Author a continuous core-to-water extension, east boundary scenery, parallax/background, and any later dock/shore geometry; no claim of pre-existing playable land.

viewportContract.note: All camera simulations apply the same world-to-screen transform to player and scenery; they are concept simulations, not runtime captures.

cameraOptions.read: Most context; player may remain too small at dense landmarks.
Recommended first gameplay test: stronger player/readability while preserving an adjacent route/landmark.
Improves player read but raises 64u corridor pressure without delivering closer scenery.

playerScaleOptions.physics: C.2 geometry validates a 32u physics body and 48u minimum; 64u corridor remains PASS_OR_WARN.

expansionReserve.current: visual-only open-water/horizon; no POI, new building, water walkability, or camera target
expansionReserve.future: Only separately authored seam activation may change this.

futureConnectionSeams.activation: Human approval + authored interior + interaction/loading/collision review
futureConnectionSeams.cameraImpact: May become a scene transition; no east land required.

futureConnectionSeams.cameraImpact: Needs Option B or a separately loaded harbor section.

futureConnectionSeams.activation: Travel-system, destination, world-boundary, and camera transition design
futureConnectionSeams.cameraImpact: Prefer separate world/scene transition; no claim of continuous current land.
